title: Cost-aware triage strip for failed requests
creator: Avery Chen
description: Design a compact, horizontal ‘triage strip’ UI component that surfaces failed requests with an explicit cost impact metric. The strip is intended for the request list and error dashboards: each card shows failure class, sample payload snippet, estimated token cost delta (by model variant), and a lightweight action set (Jump to full inspector, Retry, Mark as investigated, Create incident). Goal: reduce mean time-to-triage by making cost and severity visible at glance and enabling quick low-friction actions without leaving the list view.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype implemented in Figma with reactive variants for list density (compact / cozy / expanded)
Shows estimated token cost delta and an explanation tooltip for how cost is computed
Includes primary actions: Open Details, Retry (frontend hook), Mark Investigated, Create Incident (prefill form)
Accessible: keyboard focusable, ARIA labels for key elements, color contrast meets AA
Design reviewed and approved by PM and Eng; handoff tokens (icons, spacing, copy) documented in Confluence
design_notes: Key trade-offs: 1) Density vs. signal — compact mode truncates payloads to a deterministic 2-line preview; expanded mode shows full payload preview but only for sampled rows. 2) Cost estimation accuracy — we surface an approximate delta and link to the cost breakdown panel to avoid callers making decisions from noisy single-row estimates. 3) Actions are optimistic: Retry invokes the same route but must route through backend rate-limiting checks (ENG dependency). We intentionally avoid embedding full KV diffs in the strip to preserve performance.
decisions: Show cost delta as an integer token estimate + dollar range (min-max) instead of precise single-value pricing
Primary CTA will be 'Open Details' (left-aligned) to preserve discovery of the full inspector
Retry button will surface a confirmation popover with quick risk note (idempotency, duplicate effects)
Default list density set to 'compact' for tenant lists, with a density toggle persisted per-user

notes_for_engineering: Backend will return a 'cost_estimate' object with fields: token_estimate, cost_range_min, cost_range_max, sample_reason. UI must tolerate empty/missing estimates by rendering 'N/A' and showing a link to the cost breakdown panel. Retry action should call /requests/{id}/retry with idempotency headers. Ensure actions surface retries in the request timeline for traceability.
usability_findings: Scan test (n=4) showed 27% faster triage time with cost visible. Participants wanted clear explanation of how cost is computed and requested a 'hide cost' toggle for privacy-sensitive environments.
